scope: Capture/UI memory, Windows transitions, local API transport and Codex runtime reuse

local_compatible_transport.fixture: Offline 1.57 MB synthetic JSON request, three iterations; no network/model invocation
local_compatible_transport.limit: Measures wrapper overhead only. It does not establish TCP, TLS or model first-token latency. DeepSeek V4 retains its required thinking-field patch.

memory_changes: A newly admitted capture releases superseded encoded images instead of retaining prior full-screen PNGs
Capture asset eviction counts backing allocation capacity rather than only visible slice length
PNG compressor pools release source/output references and generic PNG encoders are not pooled
Canceled image loads release their source and handlers; closed canvases reset dimensions to zero
Mosaic buffers are created only when used and released after undo removes the last mosaic
History is loaded only on its settings tab and renders 30 entries per batch
Stopped API pool timers release references; stale expiry callbacks cannot close a freshly returned runtime
Both OCR and Codex helper processes use a Windows kill-on-close process guard
connection_regressions: Authenticated near-ready session setup can complete within a bounded handoff instead of repeating process startup and account checks
Cold successful foreground requests prepare the actual last-used prompt/direction for the next request
Hung startup/session preparation remains bounded; cancellation and obsolete settings cannot repopulate the pool
Each request retains a fresh ephemeral conversation and MCP isolation checks
ui_regressions: Native hide completes before clearing frozen pixels; late hide completion cannot erase a newer capture
Settings resize while hidden, then show after the new shell is rendered
Enter/Ctrl+C completes screenshots and Ctrl+S saves, respecting typing, IME and nested tools
Repeated copy/save is blocked while the current action is pending

validation.frontend: 324 tests across 21 files passed; threads, maxWorkers=2, testTimeout=30000, installed bundled Node 24; no project runtime or dependency changes
validation.visual: 680x780 browser preview inspected in light and dark themes; real Windows capture/hotkey, mixed-DPI and sustained memory scenarios were not manually certified

limits: Encoding measurements are in capture-encoding-2026-11-06.json. No controlled before/after aggregate process-memory measurement or live API/model latency comparison was performed. System rendering and remote generation can still dominate total latency.
